subject: general
question: Which constitutional body conducts recruitments for All India Services?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Union Public Service Commission**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) is a constitutional body in India, responsible for conducting examinations for recruitment to the various civil services of the Government of India.
 
• UPSC is mandated by Articles 315 to 323 of Part XIV of the Constitution of India.
 
• The commission is tasked with the recruitment of All India Services, Central Services, and Cadres, as well as the Armed Forces of the Union.
 
• Examinations conducted by UPSC include the Civil Services Examination, Engineering Services Examination, Combined Defence Services Examination, National Defence Academy Examination, and others.
 
• UPSC ensures a merit-based selection process through a rigorous and transparent examination system.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **All India Services (AIS)**

 
 
• These include the Indian Administrative Service (IAS), Indian Police Service (IPS), and Indian Forest Service (IFS).
 
• Officers of these services serve both the Union and the State Governments.
 
• They are recruited through a highly competitive examination process conducted by UPSC.
 
 
 
• **Constitutional Provisions**
 
 
• UPSC operates under the provisions of Articles 315 to 323 of the Indian Constitution.
 
• Article 320 outlines the functions of the UPSC, including conducting examinations and advising the government on matters related to personnel management.
 
 
 
• **UPSC Examination Process**
 
 
• The Civil Services Examination is conducted in three stages: Preliminary, Mains, and Interview.
 
• The Preliminary examination consists of objective-type questions, while the Mains examination comprises descriptive-type questions.
 
• Successful candidates from the Mains examination are called for a personal interview.
 
 
 
• **Role of UPSC**
 
 
• UPSC plays a critical role in maintaining the integrity and efficiency of the public administration system in India.
 
• It ensures that the recruitment process is free from biases and is based purely on merit.
